names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 mai, «Sfântul și Dreptul Iov, mult răbdătorul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Μαΐου, «Δίκαιος Ιώβ ο Προφήτης», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 6. мај ст. ст., „Свети праведни и многострадални Јов.“ Свети is no rank and праведни is the `righteous` this folder already carries in `types` and `honorific.js` composes back. **„и многострадални“ was read as an epithet and deliberately NOT kept, and it is the one reading in this form.** It is the very epithet the English display name carries, the Long-Suffering, and keeping it would have held this folder out of the fold with `job-the-hermit-6-march`'s bare Јов — but the heading conjoins it to the rank word with „и“, two attributive adjectives of one kind standing before the name, and splitting that conjunction to keep the second half, then giving it the initial capital the page puts on Свети alone, and then leaving it before the name where no other Serbian form in this corpus puts its epithet, is three corrections to a copied script form. A copied form is never corrected by a reader, so the bare forename is stored and the fold is declared. The question is named in this batch's commit message for the author and is one commit either way.
The heading of the calendar’s name page for 6 мая ст. ст., «Праведный Иов Многострадальный», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line declines him «Прав. Иова Многострадального».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 мая ст. ст. — «Прав. Иова Многострадального (ок. 2000-1500 до Р.Х.).»

attestations.note: The calendar gives him two lives and they do not agree about when he lived. life6631 opens «Родился в 20-м столетии до Р. X. в Аравии» and has him prosper seventy-eight years before the trial and live a hundred and forty after it; life1000 opens «жил за 2000–1500 лет до Рождества Христова, в Северной Аравии, в стране Авситидийской, в земле Уц» and gives two hundred and forty-eight years in all. The day line’s own «(ок. 2000-1500 до Р.Х.)» is the wider of the two and is recorded here rather than in `dates`, which is unchanged: it holds saint.gr’s «περί το 1650 π.Χ.» for his repose, which both Russian lives would allow. Both lives report, and life1000 marks as an opinion only — «Есть мнение, что Иов приходился племянником Аврааму» — that he was a nephew of the patriarch; nothing has been written from it. The day page prints three hymns under his name, two troparia and a kontakion, and all three are copied here with their English typed; the troparion of глас 1 is the same hymn as the Romanian one this folder already carries, and the kontakion of глас 8 the same as the Greek, each in its own language. azbyka.ru was not read. Read 8 October 2026.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 mai — «Sfântul și Dreptul Iov, mult răbdătorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Δίκαιος Ιώβ ο Προφήτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is the Job of the Old Testament book, which the page names at the end. **The Greek calls him προφήτης where the Romanian calls him only δίκαιος** — «Προφήτης επί σαράντα χρόνια» — but `types` is not changed: the folder's `righteous` is the Romanian reading, and adding `prophet` is a claim of its own; the page's word is quoted in the life instead. **The Greek adds what the folder lacked**: the land of Ausitis between Judaea and Arabia, his father Zareth and his mother Basora, the forty years of prophecy, the seven-year length of the trial, the cave outside the city, his wife's speech in full and his answer to it, the three friends by name — Eliphaz king of the Themanites, Baldad tyrant of the Sauchaeans and Saphar king of the Minaeans — the seven days of their silence, the hundred and forty years he lived afterwards and the age of two hundred and forty at which he died. **`dates` are added where the folder had none**, as a death about 1650 BC; the floruit the page gives is not recorded as an interval because the page itself gives two, «άκμασε περί το 1900 π.Χ. (κατ' άλλους το 1400 π.Χ.)», five hundred years apart, and the alternative is quoted in the note on the death instead. **Two hymns are stored, both proper and both naming him**; the page also prints a second apolytikion in Ἦχος β’, which is left in the source.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.05.2026 (6. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети праведни и многострадални Јов.“

attestations.note: **The day is Julian 6 May, the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek keep him on**, and this is the third account of him read for this folder. No existing row was moved. The identification is beyond doubt: the Book of Job's man, the estate and the children lost in one day, the sores from crown to sole, the dunghill outside the city and the piece of broken pot, the patience, and the restoration of health, wealth and seven sons and three daughters. **NO YEAR WAS TAKEN, and this is the reason.** „живљаше у Арабији око две хиљаде година пре Христа“ is a round approximation of when he lived, not a death; this folder's `death` is saint.gr's „about 1650 BC“, and **that same Greek page already carries two flourishing readings which disagree — «άκμασε περί το 1900 π.Χ. (κατ' άλλους το 1400 π.Χ.)» — which the folder deliberately leaves in its note rather than storing**. A third round approximation cannot narrow or correct that, and storing it would make the folder vaguer than its own sources allow. New to the corpus from this page: that he was **a descendant of Esau**, whom this book calls „унука Аврамова“, the patriarch's grandson — the patriarch is named only here and not in the life, because a great-grandson's genealogy is not a `related` relation and `related-floor.test.mjs` would ask for one in both directions; that he lived **in Arabia**; that his **father was Zaret and his mother Vosora**; that **his full name was Jovav**; that the trials began **in the seventy-ninth year of his life**; and that he lived **two hundred and forty-eight** years in all, where saint.gr gives two hundred and forty — a second disagreement, also recorded and not settled. **One deliberate fold**: the heading's bare Јов is already held by `job-the-hermit-6-march`, and the row is in this batch's commit message. **No `locations` were taken**: Arabia is a region and not a town, and `docs/CORPUS.md` §3's „no point beats a wrong one“ decides it. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Bogăţia virtuţilor lui Iov văzând-o vrăjmaşul drepţilor, a uneltit a o fura, şi rupând turnul trupului, vistieria duhului nu o a furat; căci a aflat întrarmat sufletul celui fără prihană, iar pe mine şi golindu-mă m-a robit. Deci mai înainte de sfârşit întâmpinându-mă, izbăveşte-mă de cel viclean, Mântuitorule, şi mă mântuieşte.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului și Dreptului Iov», Glasul 1

english.text: Seeing the wealth of Job's virtues, the enemy of the righteous plotted to steal it, and though he broke down the tower of the body he did not steal the treasury of the spirit, for he found the soul of the blameless man armed; but me he stripped and took captive. Therefore meet me before the end, O Saviour, deliver me from the evil one, and save me.

hymns.text: Ὡς τῆς ἀνδρείας ἀκαθαίρετος πύργος, τᾶς τοῦ Βελίαρ ἀπεκρούσω ἑφόδους, καὶ ἀκλινὴς διέμεινας σοφὲ ἐν πειρασμοίς, ὅθεν χαρακτῆρα σε, ἀρραγοῦς καρτερίας, καὶ λαμπρὸν ὑπόδειγμα, ἀρετῶν οὐρανίων, ἡ Ἐκκλησία μέλπει σε Ἰώβ, λαμπρυνομένη, τοὶς σοὶς προτερήμασι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, the first of two on the page of «Δίκαιος Ιώβ ο Προφήτης»

english.text: As an unshaken tower of manliness thou didst beat back the assaults of Belial, and thou didst remain unbending in temptations, O wise one. Wherefore the Church sings of thee, O Job, as the very stamp of unbroken endurance and a shining pattern of the heavenly virtues, and is made radiant by thy excellences.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἀληθὴς καὶ δίκαιος, θεοσεβὴς καὶ ἄμεμπτος, ἡγιασμένος τε ὤφθης πανένδοξε, Θεοῦ θεράπον γνήσιε· καὶ ἐδίδαξας κόσμον, ἐν τῇ σῇ καρτερίᾳ Ἰώβ πολύαθλε· ὅθεν πάντες τιμῶντες, ὑμνοῦμέν σου τὸ μνημόσυνον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχᾶς τῆς φύσεως, on the page of «Δίκαιος Ιώβ ο Προφήτης»

english.text: True and just, God-fearing and blameless, thou wast seen also to be sanctified, O all-glorious one, thou genuine servant of God; and thou didst teach the world by thine endurance, O Job of many contests. Wherefore we all honour thee and sing the memory of thee.

hymns.text: Богатство видев добродетелей Иовлих,/ украсти кознствоваше праведных враг,/ и, растерзав столп телесе,/ сокровище не украде духа,/ обрете бо вооружену непорочнаго душу,/ мене же и обнажив плени:/ предварив убо мя прежде конца,// избави мя льстиваго, Спасе, и спаси мя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь праведного Иова Многострадального», глас 1 — the same hymn as the Romanian troparion this folder already carries, in Church Slavonic

english.text: Seeing the riches of Job's virtues, the enemy of the righteous contrived to steal them away; and though he tore down the pillar of his body, he did not steal the treasure of his spirit, for he found the blameless man's soul in arms. But me he has stripped bare and taken captive. Come, then, before my end, O Saviour, deliver me from the deceiver and save me.

hymns.text: Память праведнаго Твоего Иова, Господи, празднующе,/ тем Тя молим:/ избави нас от наветов и сетей лукаваго диавола/ и спаси души наша, яко Человеколюбец.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 мая ст. ст., «Ин тропарь праведного Иова Многострадального», глас 2 — the day page prints a second troparion under that heading

english.text: Keeping the feast of the memory of thy righteous Job, O Lord, we pray thee through him: deliver us from the plots and the snares of the wicked devil, and save our souls, for thou lovest mankind.

hymns.text: Яко истинен и праведен, богочестив и непорочен,/ освящен же явлься, всеславне, Божий угодниче истинный,/ просветил еси мир в терпении твоем, терпеливейший и доблейший.// Темже вси, богомудре, память твою воспеваем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 мая ст. ст., «Кондак праведного Иова Многострадального», глас 8 — the same hymn as the Greek kontakion this folder already carries, in Church Slavonic

english.text: True and righteous, godly and blameless, thou wast shown forth as one hallowed, all-glorious and true servant of God; by thy patience thou hast enlightened the world, most patient and most valiant of men. Therefore do we all, O wise in God, sing the praise of thy memory.

death.note: saint.gr: «Έζησε, μετά τη δοκιμασία του, επί εκατόν σαράντα έτη και σε ηλικία διακοσίων σαράντα ετών, περί το 1650 π.Χ., κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη.» The same page dates his flourishing twice over and the two do not agree — «άκμασε περί το 1900 π.Χ. (κατ' άλλους το 1400 π.Χ.)» — so only the year it gives for his death is recorded, and the disagreement is left here.
